probes.name: paragraph-1
probes.text: Morning light was coming through the kitchen window when I began packing my bag. We were going somewhere new for the weekend, so I checked the address again before leaving. At the garden gate, a neighbor asked whether we could bring back a small jar of honey from the market.

probes.name: paragraph-2
probes.text: The library was changing its opening hours at the beginning of the month. Our group met there on Tuesday to plan a small reading event. We agreed to leave the main entrance clear, hang a sign near the stairs, and give visitors a quiet place to sit after lunch.

probes.name: paragraph-3
probes.text: On the way home, we stopped at the shop for eggs, rice, and a bag of apples. A dog was waiting beside the door while its owner paid for groceries. The bus arrived just as we reached the crossing, and I was glad to put the shopping down for a while.
